items.type:

items.informal_description: For any scalar $ a $ in the semiring $ R $, the weighted order of a multivariate power series $ f $ with respect to a weight function $ w $ satisfies $ \operatorname{ord}_w(f) \leq \operatorname{ord}_w(a \cdot f) $, where $ \operatorname{ord}_w $ denotes the minimal weighted degree of non-zero monomials in the series.

items.type:

items.informal_description: If $ g $ is analytic at $ x $ and $ g(x) \neq 0 $, then the meromorphic order of $ g \cdot f $ at $ x $ equals the meromorphic order of $ f $ at $ x $. Formally, $ \operatorname{ord}_x(g \cdot f) = \operatorname{ord}_x(f) $.

items.type:

items.informal_description: For a weight function $ w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $ and multivariate power series $ f, g $, the weighted order of the product $ f \cdot g $ with respect to $ w $ is equal to the sum of the weighted orders of $ f $ and $ g $ with respect to $ w $. Formally, $ \operatorname{weightedOrder}_w(fg) = \operatorname{weightedOrder}_w(f) + \operatorname{weightedOrder}_w(g) $.

∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} [inst : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_1 : OrderTop T] [inst_2 : Semiring R]
  [inst_3 : AddMonoid A] [inst_4 : AddMonoid T] [AddLeftMono T] [AddRightMono T] {degt : A → T},
  0 ≤ degt 0 →
    (∀ (a b : A), degt a + degt b ≤ degt (a + b)) →
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : AddMonoidAlgebra R A), n • f.support.inf degt ≤ (f ^ n).support.inf degt
items.informal_description: Let $ R $ be a semiring and $ A $ an additive monoid. For any function $ \deg : A \to \mathbb{R} $ satisfying $ \deg(0) \geq 0 $ and $ \deg(a + b) \geq \deg(a) + \deg(b) $ for all $ a, b \in A $, and for any $ f \in R[A] $ and $ n \in \mathbb{N} $, the inequality $ n \cdot \inf_{a \in \text{supp}(f)} \deg(a) \leq \inf_{a \in \text{supp}(f^n)} \deg(a) $ holds, where $ \text{supp}(f) $ denotes the support of $ f $.

items.informal_name: Infimum degree of an element in the additive monoid algebra
items.type:
{R : Type u_1} →
  {A : Type u_3} →
    {T : Type u_4} →
      [inst : Semiring R] → [inst_1 : SemilatticeInf T] → [OrderTop T] → (A → T) → AddMonoidAlgebra R A → T
items.informal_description: For an element $ f $ in the additive monoid algebra $ R[A] $, this function computes the infimum (greatest lower bound) of the degrees of the elements in its support, where the support consists of the non-zero terms of $ f $. The infimum is taken with respect to the degree ordering $ D $ on the additive monoid $ A $, starting from the top element and iteratively combining with the degrees of each term in the support.

items.informal_name: Supremum Degree of Non-zero Singleton in Additive Monoid Algebra Equals Element Degree
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_5} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : SemilatticeSup B] [inst_2 : OrderBot B]
  {D : A → B} (a : A) {r : R}, r ≠ 0 → AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree D (AddMonoidAlgebra.single a r) = D a
items.informal_description: For an element $a$ in an additive monoid $A$ and a non-zero scalar $r$ in a semiring $R$, the supremum degree of the basis element $\text{single}(a, r)$ in the additive monoid algebra $R[A]$ with respect to a degree function $D$ is equal to $D(a)$. This follows because the support of $\text{single}(a, r)$ contains only $a$, making $D(a)$ the maximum degree in its support.

items.informal_name: Support of Product with Basis Element in Additive Monoid Algebra
items.type:
∀ {k : Type u₁} {G : Type u₂} [inst : Semiring k] [inst_1 : Add G] [inst_2 : IsLeftCancelAdd G]
  (f : AddMonoidAlgebra k G) (r : k),
  (∀ (y : k), r * y = 0 ↔ y = 0) →
    ∀ (x : G), (AddMonoidAlgebra.single x r * f).support = Finset.map (addLeftEmbedding x) f.support
items.informal_description: For a semiring $ k $ and a left-cancellative additive monoid $ G $, if $ r $ is a non-zero divisor in $ k $, then the support of the product of the basis element $ \delta_x(r) $ with an element $ f \in \text{AddMonoidAlgebra}\, k\, G $ is the image of the support of $ f $ under the left addition embedding by $ x $. Formally, $ \text{support}(\delta_x(r) \cdot f) = \text{map}(\text{addLeftEmbedding}(x), \text{support}(f)) $.

items.informal_name: Subadditivity of Support Infimum under Multiplication in Additive Monoid Algebra
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} [inst : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_1 : OrderTop T] [inst_2 : Semiring R]
  [inst_3 : Add A] [inst_4 : Add T] [AddLeftMono T] [AddRightMono T] {degt : A → T},
  (∀ (a b : A), degt a + degt b ≤ degt (a + b)) →
    ∀ (f g : AddMonoidAlgebra R A), f.support.inf degt + g.support.inf degt ≤ (f * g).support.inf degt
items.informal_description: For any subadditive degree function $\deg : A \to T$ on an additive monoid $A$, and for all elements $f, g$ in the additive monoid algebra $R[A]$, the sum of the infima of the supports of $f$ and $g$ under $\deg$ is less than or equal to the infimum of the support of their product $f \cdot g$ under $\deg$. Formally, $\inf_{\text{supp}(f)} \deg + \inf_{\text{supp}(g)} \deg \leq \inf_{\text{supp}(f \cdot g)} \deg$.
